cells.behavior: Versioned Django 6.0 documented feature families; REST functionality inspired by DRF; task workflows inspired by Celery 5.6. Go-native APIs, no Python wire/API compatibility promise.
Every page describes target behavior. Symbols are proposed exported APIs and private owners. The repository has no Go implementation.
Go structs + Schema() descriptors; generated typed query fields and registry code; frozen runtime metadata. No duplicate handwritten schema files.
Gogo template engine with Django-style inheritance, filters, tags and partials; escaped HTML by default. Custom engine contract remains public.
Server-rendered HTML with embedded CSS/JS and progressive enhancement; no client application build required.
pgx via database/sql for common relational execution; go-redis for Redis. Gogo owns query/schema/task behavior above maintained drivers.
Local filesystem storage shipped with Core; object-storage/direct-multipart contracts and flows defined; S3/GCS adapters are future integrations.
cells.status: Initial external connectors limited to PG/Redis

cells.behavior: PostGIS extension on the PostgreSQL connector; geometry/geography, spatial lookups, aggregates, imports and maps. Native GIS adapters are capability-gated.
cells.status: Optional contrib capability; no second DB connector

cells.behavior: Go net/http handlers and context cancellation; no Python sync/async function split. Task workers are separate from request goroutines.
At-least-once attempts with acknowledgement after terminal persistence; task effects need idempotency. No universal exactly-once side-effect claim.
Cooperative cancellation in goroutine workers; isolated subprocess mode for killable hard limits. Arbitrary goroutines cannot safely be killed.
Resource layer explicitly supplies scope; ORM does not infer actor permission. Admin/API apply scope before counts, pagination and serialization.
Common operations portable; vendor features explicit and checked. Future connector cannot silently reinterpret unsupported model fields or migration operations.
OAuth/OIDC, MFA, object storage and third-party monitoring use public extension contracts; no unselected hosted provider is assumed configured.
AgentFlow alone owns architecture state and review. This is a new product; prior framework code and specification workflows are not inputs.
Submit proposed diagrams for explicit review. No architecture approval or framework implementation is performed by this task.
